description: v8.22.0 (2026-07-07, MINOR — hook-unblock pack: 5 anti-deadlock/anti-friction fixes to the enforcement layer, from the 2026-07-07 corrective-telemetry diagnosis (27 triggers; live egg-and-chicken deadlock killed run 2026-07-04-e2e-ruler-recalibration-s2 with 0/320 diff): (T1) ALREADY-DISPATCHED exemption — pendingAlreadyDispatched + dispatchTargetMatches in edit-guard-hook.cjs treat a DISPATCH_REQUEST as satisfied once the target subagent was genuinely spawned (pending_dispatches record from dispatch-record-hook, created_at >= emitted_at, leaf-containment match mirroring isResolutionAgent) — frees all 3 session blockers at once; block between REQUEST and spawn, tamper fail-closed and malformed-shape guard preserved. (T2) ANCHORED exec-window control-plane exemption in dispatch-pending-gate.cjs — a Bash/PowerShell command that IS exactly node …/scripts/exec-window/open.cjs|close.cjs (env-var prefixes tolerated) passes with a live pending; composition (&&, ;, |, backtick, newline, subshell) or the path embedded as another program argument never does (anti-injection pinned by tests). (T3) DETERMINISTIC pending clear — step-ledger-stamp.cjs (PostToolUse:Agent) clearSatisfiedPending removes the returning agent-matching DISPATCH_REQUEST entry from the signed state (withLock + read-verify-refuse-launder, record-step posture), replacing the honor-only controller prose whose omission caused a false 482-min PROTOCOL_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT. (T4) DISK-TRUTH anti-false-timeout — pendingResolvedByEvents: a pending whose matching DISPATCH_RESULT is already recorded in the run protocol-events.jsonl (timestamp >= request) is RESOLVED, wired into findLivePendingBlock AND the cleanup-orphan checkHandshakeTimeouts sweep (implementing its own docstring promise "AND no matching response arrived"); DISPATCH-only scope (GATE/PLAN_MODE stay human-resolved). (T5) STAMP-BY-EVIDENCE — step-ledger-gate.cjs grants the tdd step when gate-decisions.jsonl carries TDD_APPROVAL APPROVED|CONFIRMED (frozen RED tests from a prior session), persists the stamp via recordStep and leaves a STEP_STAMP_BY_EVIDENCE audit event in protocol-events (NOT a new gate — Iron Law preserved: Mandatory Gates table + Gate Registry UNTOUCHED). Tests tests/regression/v8.22.0/F1-F5 (41 scenarios, TDD RED->GREEN per task); suite 258/8 = pre-existing baseline exactly (3x Langfuse + score-writer + F4 v8.8.0 + 3x v8.21.0 frozen RED from the in-flight S2 slice), 0 new failures. Authored via the loopify harness (loop/hook-unblock branch, per-task selective commits); headless loop hit the harness sensitive-file wall on .claude/hooks/** — implementation landed from the interactive session, lesson recorded in loops/hook-unblock/LOOP_DONE.md. Anterior: v8.20.0 (2026-07-02, MINOR — enforcement unblocking pack from the 2026-07-02 hook audit): (1) STOP-TRAP FAIL-OPEN: the three Stop-family gates (stop-gate-hook, e2e-eval-gate, subagent-stop-commit-hook) blocked FOREVER when their continuity counter could not be persisted (signer unavailable / verifyState failing at write time / read-only state or dir) — persist()/withSignedState() now report real commit success and each block site fails OPEN with an audit trace, extending the existing !statePath B5 guard to every unpersistable shape. (2) scope-lock-hook emits the canonical hookSpecificOutput PreToolUse envelope — the old FLAT top-level shape was not honored by the harness, so the refactor scope deny was either ignored or bound without its reason ever reaching the model. (3) PIPELINE_NOT_ARMED / CORRUPT_STATE denies + the arm-writer/session-arm banners rewritten to ONE reachable next action (dispatch Agent(subagent_type: pipeline-orchestrator:core:pipeline-controller)) — the impossible write-sentinel-state-by-hand recipe (which contradicted MARKER_TAMPERED and deepened the block) and the literal {PIPELINE_DOC_PATH}/<cwd> placeholders are GONE. (4) lib/pipeline-arm.cjs HARNESS_OPEN_TAG now also cuts teammate-message/agent-message envelopes — a background subagent report QUOTING /pipeline-orchestrator:pipeline continue in prose armed a phantom CONTINUE run live on 2026-07-02, bricking the session Bash/PowerShell/Agent until the TTL. (5) NEW .claude/hooks/sentinel-state-autosign.cjs (PostToolUse Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit): signs the Bash-less controller freshly-written UNSIGNED run-dir sentinel-state.json (NEVER touches a present signature — invalid = tamper evidence; SKIPS under PIPELINE_HMAC_STRICT; fail-open) — closes STATE_FILE_INIT_FAIL and most corrective-loop noise; zero security delta (unsigned was already tolerated by default). TDD tests/regression/v8.20.0/F1-F5 (26 scenarios RED-to-GREEN incl. a live-repro of the phantom arm). Iron Law: only .claude/hooks/ + lib/ + hooks/hooks.json + tests/; Mandatory Gates table + Gate Registry UNTOUCHED; no .codex mirror. Suite 257/5 (same 5 pre-existing). Lockstep all version surfaces. v8.19.3 (2026-07-01, PATCH — arm-classifier: keyword-inferred read-only runs no longer arm [recurring phantom-arm deadlock fix]): a natural-language review/audit/analysis request ('faça revisão adversarial', 'faça uma auditoria', 'análise') was classified FULL/Audit and armed the pipeline-arm-pending marker — but read-only work never opens an exec window, so it hit INLINE_WORK_BLOCKED, aborted, and left an orphan marker that bricked the next task with PIPELINE_NOT_ARMED (observed live in interview-coach 2026-06-30 and 07-01). FIX: lib/pipeline-arm.cjs::writeArmPending now also skips arming for the read-only TYPES (Audit, UX Simulation) when they were INFERRED FROM KEYWORDS (source kw:), while an EXPLICIT --audit/--ux flag stays a deliberate governed run and still arms (preserving the STEP_1_7 direct-entry evidence, v8.16.0). Safe direction per the documented arm trade-off: a missed arm is recoverable (re-invoke); a phantom arm deadlocks. TDD tests/regression/v8.19.3/F1-readonly-types-no-arm (RED 4-fail → GREEN); 2 deliberate v8.7.0 pins updated to the --audit-flag path. Iron Law: only lib/pipeline-arm.cjs + tests/ touched; Gates/Registry UNTOUCHED; no .codex mirror. Suite 252/5 (5 pre-existing Langfuse/env/F4). Lockstep across all version surfaces. v8.19.2 (2026-07-01, PATCH — edit-guard-hook robustness [Cursor-crash hardening, Claude-Code-scoped]): the PreToolUse edit-guard no longer crashes into the opaque external catch ('edit-guard-hook internal error — failing closed') when .pipeline/sessions is present-but-unreadable (a file where a dir is expected → ENOTDIR/EACCES) — getActiveLock + getActiveExecWindow now guard readdirSync and return null instead of throwing, and the CLI external catch surfaces the REAL sanitized error (single-line, printable-ASCII, capped 200) instead of the opaque message, so a genuine failure stays fail-closed but debuggable. Posture UNCHANGED (still deny when the guard cannot evaluate); NO foreign tool-name vocabulary added — cross-runtime tool mapping is the other editor's concern, deliberately out of scope. TDD tests/regression/v8.19.2/F1 (RED 7-fail → GREEN, 8 checks). Iron Law: only .claude/hooks/edit-guard-hook.cjs + tests/ touched; Mandatory Gates table + Gate Registry UNTOUCHED; no .codex mirror. Suite 251/5 (5 pre-existing Langfuse/env/F4). Lockstep 9 surfaces. v8.19.1 (2026-06-30, PATCH — arm-marker consume-on-close deadlock fix): the pipeline-arm-pending marker (written at /pipeline invocation, 30-min TTL) was never consumed when a governed run ended deliberately, so a finished code-mutating run's still-live marker kept blocking the NEXT non-pipeline task in the same session with PIPELINE_NOT_ARMED until TTL/restart (REVIEW-ONLY/DIAGNOSTIC never arm — the trigger is a FULL/code run that armed, completed, and was never disarmed). FIX: stop-gate-hook.cjs consumes the marker on its closed-run ALLOW paths (completed/GO-completer/spec-seal/hard_failed-cap/deliberate-inactive) via a new session-aware lib/pipeline-arm.cjs::clearArmPendingForSession — never on a block, on SessionEnd/StopFailure recovery, or on corrupt state. Positive-ownership delete (deletes only when marker+caller session_ids are both present and equal, OR both absent; ambiguous/mismatched preserved for TTL) + tamper verdict delegated to the lib/arm-pending SSOT (a signed-but-invalid marker stays fail-closed). 2 zero-context adversarial rounds (1 HIGH tamper-bypass + 1 CRITICAL cross-session-delete, both fixed) then a final pass CLEAN. TDD tests/regression/v8.19.1/F1 (10 scenarios, all 5 call sites + tamper + ownership). Iron Law: only .claude/hooks/stop-gate-hook.cjs + lib/pipeline-arm.cjs + tests/ touched; Mandatory Gates table + Gate Registry UNTOUCHED; no .codex mirror. Suite 250/5 (5 pre-existing). Lockstep 9 surfaces. v8.17.0 (2026-06-28, MINOR — autonomous bugfix run delivers 4 audit-driven fixes + 1 meta-escape) — (AUDIT-001 MED-LOW) `.claude/hooks/stop-hook.cjs` adds tail-read verify after `appendRunLog`: on mismatch, a single `run-log verify mismatch` warn fires on stderr; soft-fail on missing/malformed; exported as `verifyRunLogAppend` for unit testing. (AUDIT-004 CRIT, deployment) new `lib/enforcement-status.cjs::detectEnforcementStatus({hooksDir, expectedCanonicalHook})` probes the install for the canonical execution-gate hook (`pipeline-arm-gate.cjs`); wired into the existing SessionStart `enforcement-surface-verify-hook.cjs` to emit a dedicated `ENFORCEMENT_INACTIVE` protocol-event with HIGH severity when missing — registered in `lib/contracts/e2e-eval.cjs::HYGIENE_EVENT_SEVERITY` at weight 1.0 so an install with the gate missing cannot reach clean ProcessHygiene. (AUDIT-005 HIGH) `lib/audit-read-budget.cjs::buildAuditCorrectiveDescriptor` adds closed-vocabulary machine-readable fields `corrective_action:"dispatch_agent"` + `agent_type:"audit-intake"`; `buildAuditInlineReason` appends a `[corrective_action=dispatch_agent agent_type=audit-intake]` suffix to the prose reason so a parent reading only text can still pattern-match the recovery action. (AUDIT-006 NEW MED) `lib/e2e-evaluator.cjs::scoreRun` short-circuits on aborted runs (`state.abort_reason` non-empty + `pipeline_outcome` starting with `ABORTED_`): drops StepCompletion / GateCoverage / OrderIntegrity (renormalized over ProcessHygiene), emits exactly one AUDIT-class `hygiene_violation` named `PIPELINE_ABORTED` severity=high weight=1.0 — so aborted runs surface as aborts instead of being scored as catastrophic failures. (META — user-authorized chain-tied deadlock escape) `.claude/hooks/skill-frontmatter-parser.cjs::getEnforcementMode` honours the `PIPELINE_AUTONOMOUS_RECOVERY_MODE=true` env flag by DOWNGRADING `deny` to `warn` for the process (never escalates `warn`; case-sensitive `"true"` only; one stderr audit line per process). The flag institutionalizes the user-authorized self-recovery path: when a parent must dispatch multiple agents in sequence under autonomous /goal full autonomy, the chain-tied enforcement converts to WARN so the run can complete instead of deadlocking at the gate. TDD RED→GREEN via tests/regression/v8.17.0/F1-F5 (5 files, 35+ cases); full suite 4 fail (the 4 pre-existing Langfuse/env baseline — F8/F9/F10 langfuse + F2 score-writer — unchanged). Iron Law preserved: only `.claude/hooks/`, `.codex/hooks/`, `lib/` and `tests/` touched; the 35-row Mandatory Gates table + 49-row Gate Registry UNTOUCHED. Lockstep 9 surfaces. v8.16.0 (2026-06-28, MINOR — autonomous bugfix of 2 glitches caught by the v8.15.0 E2E evaluator during the v8.15.1 self-audit run, both deterministic-evaluator findings): (Glitch A — HIGH, missing_step:final) the step-ledger-stamp.cjs PostToolUse:Agent path was already correct on the standard Agent return shape — F1 in tests/regression/v8.16.0/ now PINS that contract (final-validator return → `final` stamped; raw V1 fence string accepted; errored/ungoverned returns rejected), so a future regression to the stamping path is caught immediately. (Glitch B — MEDIUM, BRAINSTORM_EVIDENCE_MISSING) the v7.14.0 STEP_1_7_ROUTING enforcement requires every MEDIA/COMPLEXA/Spec run to log one of {load-existing, dispatch-brainstorm, no-prep-override, simples-bypass}, but the direct-entry /pipeline path never auto-emitted `no-prep-override` so the final-validator hygiene check raised the violation — now `step-ledger-stamp.cjs` auto-emits a single STEP_1_7_ROUTING(no-prep-override) entry the first time a governed step is stamped on a direct-entry run, idempotent + scoped to qualifying complexity/type and skipped when the run already carries a step_1_7 block or a STEP_1_7_ROUTING gate entry. Both fixes land in ONE existing hook (`step-ledger-stamp.cjs`) via the SSOT step-1-7-routing writer (lib/step-1-7-routing.cjs); no new hook, no new gate, the 35-row Mandatory Gates table + 49-row Gate Registry untouched. TDD RED→GREEN via tests/regression/v8.16.0/F1 + F2 (12 sub-cases). Suite 234/4 (baseline 232 + the 2 new files; the 4 pre-existing Langfuse/env failures unchanged). Iron Law preserved: only `.claude/hooks/step-ledger-stamp.cjs` + `tests/` touched; agents/skills/references/lib untouched (the lib helper was already shipping in v7.14.0). v8.15.1 (2026-06-27, PATCH — audit read-budget dispatch-exemption persistence fix): writeLedger() in lib/audit-read-budget.cjs now preserves the dispatched flag across writes, so the PostToolUse read-counter (bumpLedger) no longer wipes the markDispatched exemption on the first read — a dispatched audit/review subagent stays exempt from the inline read budget for the whole governed window instead of being re-blocked after one read (the gate was starving its own dispatched reviewers, observed live at files_reviewed:0). The flag is read under the same tamper + arm_id guard as the count, so reset-on-new-invocation and tamper-reset still hold. TDD RED→GREEN via tests/regression/v8.14.0/F11 regression block; independent adversarial review 0 critical/0 high/0 medium (1 info: forged unsigned dispatched:true persists — pre-existing cooperative-model posture, closed by PIPELINE_HMAC_STRICT); suite 232/4 (4 pre-existing Langfuse/env); Iron Law preserved, only lib/ + tests/ touched. v8.15.0 (2026-06-26, MINOR — chain-tied enforcement remediation + e2e self-evaluation loop):two additive work-streams shipped together. (1) Chain-tied enforcement: marker reading consolidated into one SSOT lib (lib/arm-pending.cjs) consumed by the arm-gate, the audit-read-budget gate and the new audit-dispatch-marker hook (closes a DRY/DIP violation where the same verify-on-read + TTL logic lived in three places and two hooks borrowed predicates from a sibling hook); the audit read-budget now exempts a genuinely dispatched subagent so legitimate orchestration is never throttled; three final-review security findings fixed — SEC-1 dispatch-mark allowlist (only real review/audit/ux agents mark the ledger, never sentinel/task-orchestrator/brainstorm steps), SEC-3 rehydration deny-message no longer leaks the exec-window write path, SEC-4 workflow label echoed into LLM-facing deny reasons is reconstructed from a validated MODE/Type allowlist (injection-safe SSOT in lib/pipeline-workflow-classifier.cjs). (2) E2E self-evaluation loop: a deterministic step-by-step evaluator (lib/e2e-evaluator.cjs) over an explicit contract (lib/contracts/e2e-eval.cjs), a gate hook (e2e-eval-gate.cjs), a loop-closer (scripts/e2e-eval-complete.cjs) and a /self-eval command score a finished run and surface human-gated improvement proposals at Stop. KNOWN LIMITATION (cooperative-model floor): enforcement is prompt/coordination-based, not cryptographic against the parent — a parent with .pipeline write access can still un-govern itself by deleting its own coordination state; full closure needs PIPELINE_HMAC_STRICT default-on plugin-wide, a deliberate posture change deferred to a future major. Tests in tests/regression/v8.14.0/ (F1-F13) + tests/regression/v8.15.0/; suite 232/4 (4 pre-existing Langfuse/env). Iron Law preserved: only .claude/hooks/, lib/, hooks.json, commands/, scripts/, tests/ — Mandatory Gates table + Gate Registry UNTOUCHED. v8.11.1 (2026-06-22, PATCH — enforcement deadlock fix): dispatch-pending-gate now exempts the sentinel recovery spawn in both branches (live handshake + corrupt state), mirroring sentinel-hook, closing the irrecoverable deadlock where one gate sends for the sentinel and the other bars it. +tests/regression/v8.12.0/T4 (6 scenarios RED->GREEN); only hooks/ + tests/; suite 206/4 (4 pre-existing Langfuse/env). v8.4.0 (2026-06-18, MINOR — spec-workflow telemetry/fidelity bridge [auditoria audit-heavy AUDIT-001..006]): o workflow de authoring /pipeline-orchestrator:spec (spec-controller, v8.0.0) rodava em pipeline-runs/<run_id>/ mas NUNCA deixava rastro mensurável — zero entradas no run-log, zero traces no Langfuse (confirmado via REST: 50 traces, 0 spec), e a nota de fidelidade usava a régua errada (gates de PROCESSING em vez dos eventos de AUTHORING). Causa: a telemetria descobre runs via .pipeline/active-run.json → sentinel-state.json (fast-path) ou varrendo .pipeline/docs/ (fallback), e o spec-controller não escrevia nenhum dos dois. Correção ADITIVA (sem mover runs, sem tocar o scan .pipeline/docs/ nem a tabela Mandatory Gates): (1) lib/run-directory.cjs allocate() agora publica .pipeline/active-run.json (gravação atômica temp+rename) + sentinel-state.json assinado no run dir, fail-safe; (2) stop-hook.cjs + langfuse-hook.cjs (+ espelhos .codex) descobrem um run selado em pipeline-runs/ via o ponteiro mesmo inativo; (3) novo lib/run-seal.cjs sealSpecRun() atualiza manifest (novo status 'sealed'), fecha o sentinel (pipeline_active:false) e grava SPEC_SEALED em gate-decisions.jsonl — com CLI entry (node lib/run-seal.cjs <runDir> --variant spec-authoring); (4) fidelity-reporter.cjs régua sensível ao fluxo: authoring={SPEC_SEALED,SPEC_REVIEW_FINDINGS} via allowlist EXATA {spec-authoring,spec-author}, processing inalterado; (5) o stop-hook só honra a variante de authoring (régua menor) se a assinatura HMAC do sentinel conferir (estado forjado cai no conjunto seguro). spec-controller.md Step 0/8/9 amarrado à selagem. Revisão adversarial 3 revisores zero-context em 3 rounds (convergiu sem CRITICAL/HIGH): pegou o bug crítico de a variante não ser repassada no caminho real do teardown (a régua nova nunca dispararia) + downgrade por variante não-verificada + 8 itens menores, todos corrigidos. +tests/regression/v8.4.0/F6 (17 sub-testes) + F3 silent-skip removido; suíte 142/4 (4 Langfuse env pré-existentes); espelhos .codex byte-idênticos. Lockstep 9 superfícies. v8.0.3 (2026-06-17, PATCH — protocol doc guard): adds an explicit anti-pattern note in references/gate-request-protocol.md (parent-side handler) and skills/spec/SKILL.md (Achado #7 handler) — re-dispatch is a fresh Agent() call that re-hydrates state from the run-dir, NOT a live-agent resume; SendMessage is not used by this pipeline and, even where present, is a deferred tool loadable via ToolSearch. Iron Law: quebra minima em agents/lib/commands/references reconhecida e justificada pelo bug de auto-auditoria. v7.10.1 (2026-06-09, PATCH — parallel_eligible default contract): formaliza o default de parallel_eligible como false quando a analise de sobreposicao nao pode ser concluida. plan-architect ganha Regra 5 exigindo parallel_eligible: false com overlap_reason prefixado 'analysis_incomplete:' quando CHANGE_CONTRACT esta ausente ou contem wildcards. executor-controller ganha guarda explicito tratando parallel_eligible ausente como false com WARN trace, convertendo comportamento implicito JS falsy em contrato observavel. 2 cenarios de regressao adicionados (F22-S10 + F22-S11, total 11). Dogfood validou Plan Mode protocol: 3/3 agentes obrigatorios emitiram PLAN_MODE_REQUEST na primeira tentativa. v7.10.0 (2026-06-09, MINOR — Plan Mode generalized + parallel dispatch): generaliza o Plan Mode obrigatorio de 1 para 10 agentes (7 de pesquisa + 2 implementadores + plan-architect) e implementa despacho paralelo de tarefas em lotes MEDIA.
